help.title: Help
help.titilerDescription: This application uses TiTiler to dynamically serve raster data in Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF (COG) format. TiTiler is an open-source service for working with raster data over an HTTP API.
help.rDescription: The script below shows how to retrieve the list of available layers and download a raster crop for a given bounding box.
